name: VISCON
description: VISCON is a benchmark framework for identifying and evaluating vision hallucinations in large vision-language models. It includes a diverse image dataset with detailed scene-graph annotations and two novel evaluation pipelines to measure hallucination severity and consistency with visual concepts.
reputation: A recent benchmark for hallucination evaluation in vision-language models that is gaining attention as hallucination analysis becomes a major topic in multimodal research.
notes: Evaluates hallucinations with detailed scene-graph annotations; introduces EMD-based and Evaluate-By-Edit pipelines.
